cards.ex: We interrupt this program for breaking news: a major earthquake has struck.
cards.exUz: Dasturimizni to'xtatamiz, tezkor yangiliklar: kuchli zilzila sodir bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va muhim voqea haqidagi eng so'nggi xabar, ayniqsa televizorda.

cards.ex: I caught the news bulletin on the radio during my drive to work.
cards.exUz: Ishga ketayotib, radioda yangiliklar xabarini eshitib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Radio yoki televideniye orqali efirga uzatiladigan qisqa yangiliklar to'plami.

cards.ex: I spend too much time scrolling through my newsfeed every morning.
cards.exUz: Har kuni ertalab yangiliklar lentamni ko'rishga juda ko'p vaqt sarflayman.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda yoki veb-saytlarda chop etilgan eng so'nggi yangiliklar ro'yxati.

cards.ex: The press has been very critical of the government's new policy.
cards.exUz: Matbuot hukumatning yangi siyosatini juda tanqid qildi.
cards.uzDef: Gazetalar, jurnallar va yangiliklar tashkilotlari.

cards.ex: Are they really going to run that story without confirming the facts?
cards.exUz: Ular faktlarni tasdiqlamasdan, shu maqolani chop etishadimi?
cards.uzDef: Gazetada, veb-saytda yoki boshqa nashrda maqola nashr etish.

cards.ex: The trial became a media circus, with reporters camped outside the courthouse.
cards.exUz: Sud jarayoni media shov-shuviga aylandi, muxbirlar sud binosi tashqarisida joylashishdi.
cards.uzDef: Jamoatchilik e'tiborini tortgan va juda ko'p matbuot e'tiborini qaratgan voqea.

cards.ex: The magazine goes to press next week, so the deadline is tight.
cards.exUz: Jurnal kelasi hafta bosmaga topshiriladi, shuning uchun muddat qisqa.
cards.uzDef: Gazeta, jurnal yoki kitob nashr etilishga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: I finally got a byline on a front-page story!
cards.exUz: Nihoyat, birinchi sahifadagi maqolada muallifligimni oldim!
cards.uzDef: Gazeta maqolasida yoki boshqa nashrda muallif sifatida nomingizni ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Good journalists always source their information carefully.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi jurnalistlar har doim ma'lumot manbalarini diqqat bilan aniqlaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Maqola uchun ma'lumot beradigan odam yoki joyni aniqlash.

cards.ex: The fact-checking process is crucial for maintaining journalistic integrity.
cards.exUz: Faktlarni tekshirish jarayoni jurnalistik halollikni saqlash uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Nashr qilishdan oldin ma'lumotlarning to'g'riligini tekshirish jarayoni.

cards.ex: That article about the CEO sounded more like a puff piece than a serious profile.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor haqidagi maqola jiddiy profilga emas, ko'proq maqtov maqolasiga o'xshardi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxs, tashkilot yoki mahsulotni tanqidiy tahlilsiz maqsadli ravishda maqtaydigan maqola.

cards.ex: The article buried the lede, so it took me a while to realize what it was really about.
cards.exUz: Maqola asosiy faktni yashirdi, shuning uchun u nima haqida ekanligini tushunish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Maqolaning eng muhim ma'lumotini boshida emas, balki keyinroq taqdim etish.

cards.ex: The news landscape is dominated by a few massive media conglomerates.
cards.exUz: Yangiliklar landshaftida bir nechta yirik media konglomeratlari hukmronlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta turli media kompaniyalariga egalik qiladigan yirik korporatsiya.

cards.ex: Citizen journalists played a key role in documenting the protests.
cards.exUz: Fuqaro jurnalistlari noroziliklarni hujjatlashtirishda muhim rol o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Jurnalist bo'lmagan, lekin o'zi ko'rgan voqealar haqida xabar beradigan odam.

cards.ex: The atmosphere in the newsroom was tense as they waited for the election results.
cards.exUz: Saylov natijalarini kutishda yangiliklar xonasidagi atmosfera keskin edi.
cards.uzDef: Gazeta, televideniye stantsiyasi yoki yangiliklar veb-saytida jurnalistlar ishlaydigan xona.

cards.ex: The reporter was assigned to cover the upcoming political summit.
cards.exUz: Muxbirga bo'lajak siyosiy sammitni yoritish vazifasi yuklatildi.
cards.uzDef: Voqea haqida xabar berish, jurnalistik nuqtai nazardan yoritish.

cards.ex: The show will go on air in five minutes, so everyone needs to be ready.
cards.exUz: Ko'rsatuv besh daqiqadan keyin efirga uzatiladi, shuning uchun hamma tayyor bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Radio yoki televideniye dasturini translyatsiya qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: The government regulates the use of the airwaves to prevent interference.
cards.exUz: Hukumat xalaqit bermaslik uchun efir to'lqinlaridan foydalanishni tartibga soladi.
cards.uzDef: Radio va televideniye signallari orqali uzatiladigan elektromagnit to'lqinlar.

cards.ex: The politician's sound bite was repeated endlessly on the news.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining qisqa lavhasi yangiliklarda tinimsiz takrorlandi.
cards.uzDef: Intervyudan olingan qisqa, diqqatga sazovor ibora.

cards.ex: That article was a real hatchet job; it completely destroyed his reputation.
cards.exUz: Bu maqola haqiqiy qoralash maqolasi edi; u uning obro'sini butunlay yo'q qildi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsga yoki tashkilotga zarar yetkazish uchun mo'ljallangan tanqidiy maqola.

cards.ex: The politician accused his opponent of running a smear campaign against him.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi raqibini unga qarshi qora piar kampaniyasini olib borishda aybladi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning obro'siga zarar yetkazish uchun yolg'on yoki bo'rttirilgan ma'lumotni tarqatishga qaratilgan harakat.

cards.ex: Reporters staked out the celebrity's house, hoping to get a photo.
cards.exUz: Muxbirlar mashhurning uyini suratga olish umidida kuzatuv olib borishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror joyni kuzatish, ayniqsa yangilik olish uchun.

cards.ex: The interviewer went off on a tangent about his personal life.
cards.exUz: Intervyu beruvchi o'zining shaxsiy hayoti haqida mavzudan chetlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Muhokama qilinayotgan mavzudan uzoqlashib, boshqa narsa haqida gapirish.

cards.ex: Before you publish that article, make sure you get your facts straight.
cards.exUz: Bu maqolani nashr qilishdan oldin, faktlarni to'g'ri ekanligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ma'lumot tarqatmaslik uchun faktlarni tekshirish va to'g'ri ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilish.

cards.ex: The scandal sparked a feeding frenzy among the media.
cards.exUz: Janjal ommaviy axborot vositalari o'rtasida ommaviy axborot hujumini keltirib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Bir mavzuni haddan tashqari yoritish, ko'pincha tanqidiy yoki salbiy yo'nalishda.

cards.ex: The journalist got the scoop on the celebrity's divorce.
cards.exUz: Jurnalist mashhurning ajrashishi haqida sensatsiya oldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa ommaviy axborot vositalari nashr qilishdan oldin e'lon qilingan eksklyuziv yangilik.

cards.ex: Always cross-check your sources before publishing a story.
cards.exUz: Har doim hikoyani nashr qilishdan oldin manbalaringizni tekshirib ko'ring.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni boshqa manbalar bilan tekshirish.

cards.ex: His explanation doesn't hold water; I don't believe him.
cards.exUz: Uning izohi asosli emas; men unga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Mantiqiy va ishonchli bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The newspaper sourced the information to an anonymous government official.
cards.exUz: Gazeta ma'lumotni hukumatning anonim amaldoridan oldi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni ma'lum bir manbadan olish.

cards.ex: The reporter relied on a reliable informant to uncover the scandal.
cards.exUz: Muxbir janjalni ochish uchun ishonchli xabar beruvchiga tayanadi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri ma'lumot beradigan ishonchli manba.
